title: A Job Application Email
text:
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to ask about the job in your marketing team. I saw the advertisement on your website last week. I have three years of experience in sales, and I speak English and French. Please find my CV attached to this email. Thank you for your time.

I am available for an interview on any day next week. You can reach me by phone at 555-0142 or by email. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, Anna Brown.

questions.text: Where did the writer see the advertisement?
What phone number can the writer be reached on?
What does the writer probably want to happen next?
options: To receive a reply and be invited to an interview

questions.text: Why does the writer mention three years of experience?
options: To show that they are qualified for the job
To ask for a higher salary
To say they are leaving their company

vocabulary.definition: a notice that promotes a product or a job vacancy
knowledge or skill gained from doing something over time
free and able to do something or meet someone
included with an email, usually as a file

paragraph_translations: Sayın Bay Smith, pazarlama ekibinizdeki iş hakkında soru sormak için yazıyorum. Geçen hafta web sitenizde ilanı gördüm. Satış alanında üç yıllık deneyimim var ve İngilizce ile Fransızca konuşuyorum. Lütfen CV'mi bu e-postaya ekli olarak bulun. Zamanınız için teşekkür ederim.
Gelecek hafta herhangi bir günde mülakat için müsaitim. Bana 555-0142 numaralı telefondan veya e-posta ile ulaşabilirsiniz. Sizden haber almayı dört gözle bekliyorum. Saygılarımla, Anna Brown.
